name: app-6a843bd0acfc8191886fef07d16a6f4e
description: Turrior helps you hire directly from ChatGPT. Create jobs, source candidates, run AI video screening, and receive only video-verified applicants.

defaultPrompt: Generate a report of recent Turrior hires
Analyze my Turrior applicants and show me top matches
interface.longDescription: Turrior helps you hire directly from ChatGPT. Create jobs, source candidates, run AI video screening, and receive only video-verified applicants.

positive.description: The user asks the assistant to create a Job Post for a specific role.
positive.prompt: Create a Turrior Job Post for a Node.js Developer role with requirements for NestJS and PostgreSQL.
positive.tools_triggered: search-countries, search-categories, get-company-profile , create-new-job, create-video-quiz, attach-quiz, publish-job
positive.expected_behavior: The agent clarifies the Job Post details, offers to create a video quiz, and offers to publish the post. If any required information is missing, the agent asks the user for clarification. As a result, a Job Post will be created, and if the user chooses, it can also include a quiz and be published.

positive.description: The user asks to edit a Job Post but does not specify the exact title.
positive.prompt: Edit the Designer job at Turrior and add Photoshop as a requirement.
positive.expected_behavior: First, the agent uses `list-short-job-posts` to determine which `jobID` is being referred to. Then, it retrieves the full content of the post using `get-full-job-post`, and finally uses `patch-job` to apply the changes.

positive.description: The user asks to show candidates for a specific Job Post by referring to the role. The assistant first determines the Job Post ID using `list-short-job-posts`. Then, it retrieves the candidates.
positive.prompt: Show me the Turrior latest candidates for the Designer role.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls `list-short-job-posts` to determine which job is being referred to, then calls `get-candidates` twice with different parameters to retrieve both external and internal candidates. The assistant summarizes the retrieved data and comments on the candidates' Test Case 2 Scenarscores.

positive.description: The user asks the assistant to change a talent’s status by name and move them to another status.
positive.prompt: Move the Turrior talent `Talent Test` to the `screening` status.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant uses `get-candidates` to identify which talent is being referred to if they are not already in context, then uses `change-candidates-status` to update the candidate’s status.

positive.description: The user asks to invite the talent to a Calendly interview.
positive.prompt: Create a Calendly interview for the talent Talent Test on Turrior.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the talent (get-candidates) and creates a Calendly interview invitation (invite-candidate-to-interview).

negative.description: The user asks the assistant to simply write a job description without mentioning Turrior or job post creation. As a result, the assistant just writes the text.
negative.prompt: Write a compelling job description for a Senior Backend Engineer.

negative.description: The user asks for 10 interview questions for a Product Manager, and the assistant simply writes the questions in the chat without calling any Turrior methods.
negative.prompt: Give me 10 interview questions for a Product Manager role so I can choose which ones to use later.

negative.description: The user asks, “Cancel my Google Calendar meeting with Alex next Tuesday.” The assistant does not use Turrior functions to cancel a Calendly meeting; instead, it tries to handle the request otherwise
negative.prompt: Cancel my Google Calendar meeting with Alex next Tuesday.

review.commerce_description: My plugin links or directs users out of ChatGPT to make purchases
